verses.geez: ወ[ኮነ ፡] ሶበ ፡ አኀዙ ፡ ይብዝኁ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ምድር ፡ ወተወልዱ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ (ደቂቅ ፡ ወ)አዋልድ ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass when men began to be numerous upon the earth, and daughters were born to them,

translations.lxx: And it came to pass when men began to be numerous upon the earth, and daughters were born to them,
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born unto them,
translations.ron: Iar după ce au început a se înmulţi oamenii pe pământ şi li s-au născut fiice,

verses.geez:
ወሶበ ፡ ርእዩ ፡ ውሉደ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አዋልደ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሠናያት ፡ እማንቱ ፡ ነሥኡ ፡ እምኔሆን ፡ አንስትያ
                  ፡ ዘኀረዩ ፡ ወዘአፍቀሩ ።
verses.translation: that the sons of God having seen the daughters of men that they were beautiful, took to themselves wives of all whom they chose.

translations.lxx: that the sons of God having seen the daughters of men that they were beautiful, took to themselves wives of all whom they chose.
translations.kjv: That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.
translations.ron: Fiii lui Dumnezeu, văzând că fiicele oamenilor sunt frumoase, şi-au ales dintre ele soţii, care pe cine a voit.

verses.geez:
ወይቤ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ሶቤሃ ፡ ኢየኀድር ፡ ውስተ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ እስከ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ መንፈስየ ፡ እስመ ፡
                  እሙንቱ ፡ ዘሥጋ ፡ ባሕቱ ፡ ይኩን ፡ መዋዕሊሆሙ ፡ ፻ወ፳ዓመተ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord God said, My Spirit shall certainly not remain among these men for ever, because they are flesh, but their days shall be an hundred and twenty years.

translations.lxx: And the Lord God said, My Spirit shall certainly not remain among these men for ever, because they are flesh, but their days shall be an hundred and twenty years.
translations.kjv: And the LORD said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.
translations.ron: Dar Domnul Dumnezeu a zis: "Nu va rămâne Duhul Meu pururea în oamenii aceştia, pentru că sunt numai trup. Deci zilele lor să mai fie o sută douăzeci de ani!"

verses.geez:
ወበውእቱ ፡ መዋዕል ፡ ኮኑ ፡ እለ ፡ ያርብሕ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ እስመ ፡ ቦኡ ፡ ውሉደ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ኀበ ፡
                  አዋልደ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ወወለዳ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ያርብሕ ፡ [እለ ፡ እምነ ፡ ፍጥረተ ፡ ዓለም ፡ ዕደወ ፡ ስም] ።
verses.translation: Now the giants were upon the earth in those days; and after that when the sons of God were wont to go in to the daughters of men, they bore children to them, those were the giants of old, the men of renown.

translations.lxx: Now the giants were upon the earth in those days; and after that when the sons of God were wont to go in to the daughters of men, they bore children to them, those were the giants of old, the men of renown.
translations.kjv: There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.
translations.ron: În vremea aceea s-au ivit pe pământ uriaşi, mai cu seamă de când fiii lui Dumnezeu începuseră a intra la fiicele oamenilor şi acestea începuseră a le naşte fii: aceştia sunt vestiţii viteji din vechime.

verses.geez:
ወሶበ ፡ ርእየ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ በዝኅ ፡ እከዮሙ ፡ ለሰብእ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ምድር ፡ ወፈቃደ ፡ ሕሊናሆሙ ፡ ወልቦሙ ፡
                  እኩይ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ መዋዕል ፡
verses.translation: And the Lord God having seen that the wicked actions of men were multiplied upon the earth, and that every one in his heart was intently brooding over evil continually,

translations.lxx: And the Lord God having seen that the wicked actions of men were multiplied upon the earth, and that every one in his heart was intently brooding over evil continually,
translations.kjv: And God saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.
translations.ron: Văzând însă Domnul Dumnezeu că răutatea oamenilor s-a mărit pe pământ şi că toate cugetele şi dorinţele inimii lor sunt îndreptate la rău în toate zilele,

verses.geez: ወነስሐ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በእንተ ፡ ዘገብሮ ፡ ለሰብእ ፡ [ላዕለ ፡ ምድር ፡ ወሐለየ] ።
verses.translation: then God laid it to heart that he had made man upon the earth, and he pondered it deeply.

translations.lxx: then God laid it to heart that he had made man upon the earth, and he pondered it deeply.
translations.kjv: And it repented the LORD that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him at his heart.
translations.ron: I-a părut rău şi s-a căit Dumnezeu că a făcut pe om pe pământ.

verses.geez:
ወይቤ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ (እግዚእ ፡) እደመስሶ ፡ ለእጓለ ፡ እመሕያው ፡ ዘገበርኩ ፡ እምገጸ ፡ ምድር ፡ እምነ ፡ ሰብእ
                  ፡ እስከ ፡ እንስሳ ፡ ወአዕዋፈ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ዘይትኀወስ ፡ እስመ ፡ አነ ፡ ነሳሕኩ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ፈጢሮትየ ፡ ኪያሆሙ
                  ።
verses.translation: And God said, I will blot out man whom I have made from the face of the earth, even man with cattle, and reptiles with flying creatures of the sky, for I am grieved that I have made them.

translations.lxx: And God said, I will blot out man whom I have made from the face of the earth, even man with cattle, and reptiles with flying creatures of the sky, for I am grieved that I have made them.
translations.kjv: And the LORD said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth; both man, and beast, and the creeping thing, and the fowls of the air; for it repenteth me that I have made them.
translations.ron: Şi a zis Domnul: "Pierde-voi de pe faţa pământului pe omul pe care l-am făcut! De la om până la dobitoc şi de la târâtoare până la păsările cerului, tot voi pierde, căci Îmi pare rău că le-am făcut".

verses.geez: ወኖኅሰ ፡ ረከበ ፡ ምሕረተ ፡ ወሣህለ ፡ በቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: But Noe found grace before the Lord God.

translations.lxx: But Noe found grace before the Lord God.
translations.kjv: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD.
translations.ron: Noe însă a aflat har înaintea Domnului Dumnezeu.

verses.geez:
[ወከመዝ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ፍጥረቱ ፡ ለኖኅ ፡ ወብእሲ ፡ ጻድቅ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወፍጹም ፡] በትውልዱ ፡ ወአሥመሮ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር
                  ።
verses.translation: And these are the generations of Noe. Noe was a just man; being perfect in his generation, Noe was well-pleasing to God.

translations.lxx: And these are the generations of Noe. Noe was a just man; being perfect in his generation, Noe was well-pleasing to God.
translations.kjv: These are the generations of Noah: Noah was a just man and perfect in his generations, and Noah walked with God.
translations.ron: Iată viaţa lui Noe: Noe era om drept şi neprihănit între oamenii timpului său şi mergea pe calea Domnului.

verses.geez: ወወለደ ፡ ሠለስተ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እሉ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ሴም ፡ ወካም ፡ ወያፌት ።
verses.translation: And Noe begot three sons, Sem, Cham, Japheth.

translations.lxx: And Noe begot three sons, Sem, Cham, Japheth.
translations.kjv: And Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
translations.ron: Şi i s-au născut lui Noe trei fii: Sem, Ham şi Iafet.

verses.geez: ወማሰነት ፡ ምድር ፡ በቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወመልአት ፡ ዐመፃ ።
verses.translation: But the earth was corrupted before God, and the earth was filled with iniquity.

translations.lxx: But the earth was corrupted before God, and the earth was filled with iniquity.
translations.kjv: The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.
translations.ron: Pământul însă se stricase înaintea feţei lui Dumnezeu şi se umpluse pământul de silnicii.

verses.geez: ወርእያ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለምድር ፡ ከመ ፡ ማሰነት ፡ ወከመ ፡ አማሰኑ ፡ ፍኖቶ ፡ በዲበ ፡ ምድር ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘሥጋ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord God saw the earth, and it was corrupted; because all flesh had corrupted its way upon the earth.

translations.lxx: And the Lord God saw the earth, and it was corrupted; because all flesh had corrupted its way upon the earth.
translations.kjv: And God looked upon the earth, and, behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth.
translations.ron: Şi a căutat Domnul Dumnezeu spre pământ şi iată era stricat, căci tot trupul se abătuse de la calea sa pe pământ.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላኩ ፡ ለኖኅ ፡ ጊዜሁ ፡ ለእጓለ ፡ እመሕያው ፡ በጽሐ ፡ ቅድሜየ ፡ እስመ ፡ መልአ ፡ ዐመፃ
                  ፡ ዲበ ፡ ምድር ፡ እምኔሆሙ ፡ ወናሁ ፡ አነ ፡ እደመስሶሙ ፡ ወለምድርኒ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord God said to Noe, A period of all men is come before me; because the earth has been filled with iniquity by them, and, behold, I destroy them and the earth.

translations.lxx: And the Lord God said to Noe, A period of all men is come before me; because the earth has been filled with iniquity by them, and, behold, I destroy them and the earth.
translations.kjv: And God said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth.
translations.ron: Atunci a zis Domnul Dumnezeu către Noe: "Sosit-a înaintea feţei Mele sfârşitul a tot omul, căci s-a umplut pământul de nedreptăţile lor, şi iată Eu îi voi pierde de pe pământ.

verses.geez:
ወግበር ፡ ለከ ፡ ታቦተ ፡ እንተ ፡ ዕፅ ፡ ወርብዕት ፡ ወከመዝ ፡ ትገብራ ፡ ለይእቲ ፡ ታቦት ፡ ወትቀብኣ ፡ ፒሳ ፡
                  እንተ ፡ ውስጣ ፡ ወእንተ ፡ አፍኣሃኒ ፡ በፒሳ ።
verses.translation: Make therefore for thyself an ark of square timber; thou shalt make the ark in compartments, and thou shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.

translations.lxx: Make therefore for thyself an ark of square timber; thou shalt make the ark in compartments, and thou shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.
translations.kjv: Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.
translations.ron: Tu însă fă-ti o corabie de lemn de salcâm. În corabie să faci despărţituri şi smoleşte-o cu smoală pe dinăuntru şi pe din afară.

verses.geez: ወከመዝ ፡ ትገብራ ፡ ለይእቲ ፡ ታቦት ፡ ፫፻በእመት ፡ ኑኃ ፡ ወ[፶]በእመት ፡ ርሕባ ፡ ወ፴በእመት ፡ ስራ ።
verses.translation: And thus shalt thou make the ark; three hundred cubits the length of the ark, and fifty cubits the breadth, and thirty cubits the height of it.

translations.lxx: And thus shalt thou make the ark; three hundred cubits the length of the ark, and fifty cubits the breadth, and thirty cubits the height of it.
translations.kjv: And this is the fashion which thou shalt make it of: The length of the ark shall be three hundred cubits, the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits.
translations.ron: Corabia însă să o faci aşa: lungimea corăbiei să fie de trei sute de coţi, lăţimea ei de cincizeci de coţi, iar înălţimea de treizeci de coţi.

verses.geez:
ወአስተጋብእ ፡ ተግበራ ፡ ለይእቲ ፡ ታቦት ፡ ወሶበ ፡ በጽሐተ ፡ ለተፈጽሞ ፡ አሐቲ ፡ እመተ ፡ ተርፋ ፡ ለተፈጽሞ ፡ ህየ
                  ፡ ግበር ፡ ኆኅታ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ገቦሃ ፡ ወግበር ፡ ላቲ ፡ መዓርጋተ ፡ ተጽራሕ ፡ ወተሥላሰ ፡ ግበር ።
verses.translation: Thou shalt narrow the ark in making it, and in a cubit above thou shalt finish it, and the door of the ark thou shalt make on the side; with lower, second, and third stories thou shalt make it.

translations.lxx: Thou shalt narrow the ark in making it, and in a cubit above thou shalt finish it, and the door of the ark thou shalt make on the side; with lower, second, and third stories thou shalt make it.
translations.kjv: A window shalt thou make to the ark, and in a cubit shalt thou finish it above; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof; with lower, second, and third stories shalt thou make it.
translations.ron: Să faci corăbiei o fereastră la un cot de la acoperiş, iar uşa corăbiei să o faci într-o parte a ei. De asemenea să faci într-însa trei rânduri de cămări: jos, la mijloc şi sus.

verses.geez:
ወናሁ ፡ አነ ፡ ኣመጽእ ፡ ማየ ፡ አይኅ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ምድር ፡ ወእደመስሰ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘሥጋ ፡ ወዘመንፈሰ ፡ ሕይወት ፡ ላዕለ
                  ፡ ምድር ፡ ወዘሀሎ ፡ መትሕተ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ ወይመውት ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘሥጋ ።
verses.translation: And behold I bring a flood of water upon the earth, to destroy all flesh in which is the breath of life under heaven, and whatsoever things are upon the earth shall die.

translations.lxx: And behold I bring a flood of water upon the earth, to destroy all flesh in which is the breath of life under heaven, and whatsoever things are upon the earth shall die.
translations.kjv: And, behold, I, even I, do bring a flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh, wherein is the breath of life, from under heaven; and every thing that is in the earth shall die.
translations.ron: Şi iată Eu voi aduce asupra pământului potop de apă, ca să pierd tot trupul de sub cer, în care este suflu de viaţă, şi tot ce este pe pământ va pieri.

verses.geez: ወኣቀውም ፡ ኪዳንየ ፡ ምስሌከ ፡ ወትበውእ ፡ አንተ ፡ ወብእሲትከ ፡ ወደቂቅከ ፡ ወአንስትያ ፡ ደቂቅከ ፡ ምስሌከ ፤
verses.translation: And I will establish my covenant with thee, and thou shalt enter into the ark, and thy sons and thy wife, and thy sons' wives with thee.

translations.lxx: And I will establish my covenant with thee, and thou shalt enter into the ark, and thy sons and thy wife, and thy sons' wives with thee.
translations.kjv: But with thee will I establish my covenant; and thou shalt come into the ark, thou, and thy sons, and thy wife, and thy sons’ wives with thee.
translations.ron: Iar cu tine voi face legământul Meu; şi vei intra în corabie tu şi împreună cu tine vor intra fiii tăi, femeia ta şi femeile fiilor tăi.

verses.geez:
ወእምነ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ እንስሳ ፡ ወእምነ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘይትሐወስ ፡ ወእምነ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ አራዊት ፡ ወእምነ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘሥጋ ፡
                  ታበውእ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ ወታበውእ ፡ ምስሌከ ፡ ተባዕተ ፡ ወአንስተ ።
verses.translation: And of all cattle and of all reptiles and of all wild beasts, even of all flesh, thou shalt bring by pairs of all, into the ark, that thou mayest feed them with thyself: male and female they shall be.

translations.lxx: And of all cattle and of all reptiles and of all wild beasts, even of all flesh, thou shalt bring by pairs of all, into the ark, that thou mayest feed them with thyself: male and female they shall be.
translations.kjv: And of every living thing of all flesh, two of every sort shalt thou bring into the ark, to keep them alive with thee; they shall be male and female.
translations.ron: Să intre în corabie din toate animalele, din toate târâtoarele, din toate fiarele şi din tot trupul, câte două, parte bărbătească şi parte femeiască, ca să rămână cu tine în viaţă.

verses.geez:
ወአንተሰ ፡ ንሣእ ፡ ለከ ፡ እምነ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ መባልዕት ፡ ዘይሴሰዩ ፡ አስተጋብእ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ ወይከውነከ ፡ መብልዐ ፡ ለከ
                  ፡ ወሎሙ ፡ መብልዐ ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt take to thyself of all kinds of food which ye eat, and thou shalt gather them to thyself, and it shall be for thee and them to eat.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt take to thyself of all kinds of food which ye eat, and thou shalt gather them to thyself, and it shall be for thee and them to eat.
translations.kjv: And take thou unto thee of all food that is eaten, and thou shalt gather it to thee; and it shall be for food for thee, and for them.
translations.ron: Iar tu ia cu tine din tot felul de mâncare, cu care vă hrăniţi; îngrijeşte-te ca să fie aceasta de mâncare pentru tine şi pentru acelea".

verses.geez: ወገብረ ፡ ኖኅ ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላኩ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ገብረ ።
verses.translation: And Noe did all things whatever the Lord God commanded him, so did he.

translations.lxx: And Noe did all things whatever the Lord God commanded him, so did he.
translations.kjv: Thus did Noah; according to all that God commanded him, so did he.
translations.ron: Şi a început Noe lucrul şi precum îi poruncise Domnul Dumnezeu aşa a făcut.

note: The sons of God saw the daughters of men. Four verses that generated an entire apocalyptic tradition. Read alongside 1 Enoch 6-16 for the full Watchers narrative and Jubilees 5 for the theological interpretation.
